verdict.rationale: Every Orama Cloud project ships an auto-configured MCP server, so users can interact with their project's data in natural language from ChatGPT, Cursor and similar AI interfaces. Cloud search also offers AI-powered NLP search, and AnswerSession turns questions into sourced answers. All of this is querying and retrieval, though; nothing shows natural-language commands that operate the product itself, such as creating projects, managing data sources, inserting documents or configuring indexes. Missing for 10: natural-language control of administrative and data-management operations, documentation of which MCP tools or actions are exposed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
